name: OpenVibe.Realtime
notes: Closed by ADR-005 (accepted 2026-09-22): browser realtime is a delivery plane inside OpenVibe.Events (SSE /realtime/stream with per-topic authorisation, Last-Event-ID resume and gap markers), so OpenVibe.Realtime is not built. The repository holds its charter and the closure note only: no runtime, domain, capability or event. Reopened only as ADR-005 says (measured connection counts or fan-out latency that need an independently scaled process), by a new ADR.
